data.name: Pro Kick Online
data.detailed_description:
Pro Kick Online is a competitive online football game built for players who love fast-paced matches, skill-based gameplay, and real football excitement.

Pro Kick Online offers smooth controls, realistic ball physics, tactical team play, and intense multiplayer action where every pass, shot, and decision matters.

Create or join lobbies, play with friends, compete in custom matches, and experience football from a new perspective. Whether you prefer quick casual games or serious competitive matches, Pro Kick Online is designed to deliver fun and challenging gameplay for every football fan.

Features:

  • Online multiplayer football matches

  • Realistic ball physics and player movement

  • Team-based competitive gameplay

  • Custom lobbies and private matches

  • Skill-focused controls and mechanics

  • Continuous updates and improvements

Step onto the pitch, build your team chemistry, and prove your skills in Pro Kick Online.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor at 2.5 GHz or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any DirectX 11 or 12 compatible card for Windows
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 16 core Intel or AMD processor at 3.4 GHz or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3080
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
